notes: Posted 21 July 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine (the strategy says he will add 'that new grabber from Coruscant when it comes out').

The post has no starting section. Hunt Down And Destroy The Jedi (posted 'Hunt Down OBJ', last in the list) is the objective and Start Your Engines! the starting interrupt; Executor: Holotheatre, Executor: Meditation Chamber and Visage Of The Emperor are the cards the objective deploys. The strategy says not to start Watto's Box against a podracing opponent, so no single starting effect is shown. All count toward the 60.
Visage Of The Emperor was posted on two lines (3 and 2); the update in the strategy says one line is foil and there are 5 Visages in the deck, so they are one row of 5.
The section headers ('number card', 'Places', 'Peaople', 'Epic Events & Etc') are not cards.

Posted 'Mara Jade, TEH' dested Mara Jade, The Emperor's Hand; 'Darth Vader, DLOTS' Darth Vader, Dark Lord Of The Sith; 'Sense & UITF' Sense & Uncertain Is The Future; 'Omni Box & It's Worse' the Reflections II combo Ommni Box & It's Worse (the card's spelling).
Posted 'Tatooine Cantina', 'Tatooine Podrace Arena' and 'Boonta Eve Podrace' dested the Dark printings; 'Darth Maul' the Tatooine card; 'Darth Vader' the Premiere card.
Secret Plans was an Effect in 2001.
